interpretation.reported_uniques: Cloudflare aggregate, not a count of identified people.
interpretation.user_agents: Observations from the adaptive user-agent query; categories are not page views and may use a different window.
interpretation.retrieval: AI user-agents split by function (scripts/lib/ai-bots.mjs): live = user-triggered fetch during a conversation (closest proxy of an actual citation), search = assistant search index, training = training crawl. live_share_pct = live / all AI observations.
interpretation.edition_formats: Hits on /editions/<week>/ paths from the daily top-URL sample, split by format (HTML page vs .md / .json(l) / .txt). Sample-based: a lower bound, not a total.
interpretation.human_audience: No individual tracking. Human-likely traffic is intentionally not asserted from these aggregates.
